column2: Tool descriptions tell an agent what your docs tools do, not how to use your docs well. Agent Skills fill that gap, and your docs site can ship them.
Every build includes one skill, docs research. It's written from your site. It tells the agent to search, fetch the page, and link its source, then maps where things are.
Add your own for what only your team knows. Put each skill in a folder with a skill dot M D, and point the plugin at the parent folder.
Build the site. The plugin checks every skill, and packs it into the same bundle as your docs. There's nothing extra to deploy.
The server supports the M C P skills extension. Few hosts do yet, so its instructions also list every skill, and tell the agent to read it with docs fetch.
Here's Claude Code, with a request that fails with a four twenty nine. It reads the error skill first, searches, fetches the rate limiting section, and answers with the fix and a link.
Read the Agent Skills guide on the plugin's docs site.
